profiles.Name: Progressing Career Builders
profiles.PrimaryCharacteristics: Healthy career momentum with periodic promotions and active participation in development programs. Key internal mobility pipeline cohort.

profiles.Name: Promotion-Stalled Talent
profiles.PrimaryCharacteristics: Mid-to-senior tenure with extended promotion dry spells (>4 yrs). High retention intervention priority to prevent latent disengagement.

profiles.Name: Stable Long-Term Contributors
profiles.PrimaryCharacteristics: Experienced contributors and senior personnel with steady advancement velocity and leadership continuity. Monitor for role ceiling effects.

profiles.Name: High-Risk Stagnation Profiles
profiles.PrimaryCharacteristics: Prolonged role tenure combined with high promotion latency and training deficits. Highest anomalous stagnation density — greatest voluntary departure vulnerability.

profiles.Name: Early-Career Explorers
profiles.PrimaryCharacteristics: Early tenure (0-2.5 yrs). Prime period for onboarding, foundational capability building, and early career pathing discussions.
